objective: R3B quirurgico sobre la misma intencion de R3A, evitando reducciones destructivas. Eliminar referencias activas a EDARSAHUB_SQL_MIGRATION_USER/PASSWORD en los cuatro workflows ya clasificados, conservar su estructura y evidencia, y hacerlos fallar cerrado antes de cualquier mutacion SQL mientras no exista un writer autorizado distinto de HRLectura. HRLectura permanece solo como identidad READ_ONLY y nunca como writer. Scopear EDARSA_ALLOW_PUSH=1 exclusivamente al subprocess git push. No tocar docs/memory historicos, otros legacy pendientes, SQL ni Produccion. Todas las escrituras existentes usan expected_sha256 del HEAD vigente.

actions.content:
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

MIGRATION_WORKFLOWS = [
    ROOT / '.github/workflows/communications-gate5d-development-migration.yml',
    ROOT / '.github/workflows/catalogo-ampliado-gate8f-development-migration.yml',
    ROOT / '.github/workflows/cavas-corporativas-menu-development-migration.yml',
    ROOT / '.github/workflows/cavas-gate12i-persona-link-development-migration.yml',
]

PUBLISHERS = [
    ROOT / 'backup_a_github.sh',
    ROOT / 'tools/mirror_sync/publish_local_snapshot.sh',
    ROOT / 'tools/mirror_sync/finalize_local_snapshot.sh',
]

def test_active_migration_workflows_have_no_legacy_writer_secrets_and_fail_closed():
    for path in MIGRATION_WORKFLOWS:
        text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        assert 'EDARSAHUB_SQL_MIGRATION_USER' not in text
        assert 'EDARSAHUB_SQL_MIGRATION_PASSWORD' not in text
        assert 'MIGRATION_WRITER_STATUS=UNCONFIGURED' in text
        assert 'HRLECTURA_WRITER_FORBIDDEN=YES' in text
        assert 'MIGRATION_EXECUTED=NO' in text
        assert 'secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD' in text
        assert "EDARSAHUB_ALLOW_MIGRATIONS: 'false'" in text

def test_publish_authorization_is_scoped_to_git_push_only():
    for path in PUBLISHERS:
        text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        assert 'export EDARSA_ALLOW_PUSH=1' not in text
        assert 'EDARSA_ALLOW_PUSH=1 git push' in text
